treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Government of the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Tax Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income, with Protocol (2012)
eif_quote: [China MLI deposit position] Denmark Original 16-06-2012 27-12-2012 || [Denmark MLI position] China Original 16-06-2012 28-12-2012
source_title: Lov nr. 1096 af 28/11/2012 om indgåelse af dobbeltbeskatningsaftale mellem Danmark og Kina, Bilag 1 (Danish text of the Agreement and Protocol)

rates.quote: a) 5 pct. af bruttobeløbet af udbyttet, hvis den retmæssige ejer er et selskab (bortset fra et interessentskab), der direkte ejer mindst 25 pct. af kapitalen i det selskab, som udbetaler udbyttet;
b) 10 pct. af bruttobeløbet af udbyttet i alle andre tilfælde.

Sådanne renter kan dog også beskattes i den kontraherende stat, hvorfra de hidrører, og i henhold til lovgivningen i denne kontraherende stat, men hvis den retmæssige ejer af renterne er hjemmehørende i den anden kontraherende stat, må den pålagte skat ikke overstige 10 pct. af renternes bruttobeløb.
a) for så vidt angår royalties som nævnt i stykke 3, litra a), 10 pct. af bruttobeløbet af royaltybeløbet, og

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement. [MLI Art. 7(1) applies (both list the Agreement; WHT effect 2023-01-01 per Art. 35(1)(a)). The Agreement also has main-purpose clauses in Art. 10(6), 11(8), 12(7).]

notes: Art. 28(2)(a): withholding taxes on income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year following entry into force (2013-01-01). Art. 12(2)(b): equipment royalties (Art. 12(3)(b)) taxed at max 10% of an adjusted amount equal to 70% of the gross royalties (effective 7% of gross) - not modelled as a separate tier. Art. 11(3) + Protocol para. 2: interest paid to the other State's government, subdivisions, local authorities, central bank (People's Bank of China / Danmarks Nationalbank) or listed public institutions (CDB, ADBC, China Exim, NCSSF, Sinosure, CIC; IFU, Eksportkreditfonden, Vækstfonden), or on debt financed/guaranteed/secured by them, exempt at source (not modelled). MLI Art. 8 (365-day holding incl. payment date) applied to the 5% tier from 2023-01-01 (MLI WHT effective date; before that no holding period): China notified Art. 10(2)(a) and Denmark notified Art. 10(2) for this Agreement under Art. 8(4); neither reserved Art. 8. Entry-into-force date conflict: China list 27-12-2012 vs Denmark list 28-12-2012 (map uses 2012-12-27); no effect on valid_from. Replaced the 1986 Agreement. Danish text read; English text prevails in case of divergence.
unverified: MLI Art. 8 match: Denmark's notification cites Art. 10(2) while China's cites Art. 10(2)(a) - treated as matching; not confirmed against a synthesised text
